en.headline: Students may speak with astronaut Lai Ka-ying from September
en.dek: The Innovation, Technology and Industry Bureau is organising a Space-Earth Dialogue that could allow primary and secondary pupils to talk directly with Hong Kong’s first astronaut.
body: Secretary for Innovation, Technology and Industry Sun Dong said Hong Kong primary and secondary students may be able to speak with payload specialist Lai Ka-ying as early as September after the new school year begins.

The dialogue, also known as the Sky Classroom, is being organised by the Innovation, Technology and Industry Bureau together with the Education Bureau and relevant mainland authorities. Students would communicate directly with Lai while she is aboard the Chinese space station during the Shenzhou-23 mission.

Lai Ka-ying became Hong Kong’s first astronaut when she entered the Tiangong space station as a payload specialist earlier this year. The planned sessions are intended to inspire young people in science and space exploration.

zh.headline: 學生最早9月可與航天員黎家盈「天地對話」
zh.dek: 創新科技及工業局局長孫東表示，中小學生最早可於9月新學年開始後，透過「天地對話」直接與香港首位航天員黎家盈通話。
body: 創新科技及工業局局長孫東表示，本港中小學生最早可於9月新學年開始後，與載荷專家黎家盈進行「天地對話」。
有關活動由創新科技及工業局聯同教育局及內地相關單位籌辦，又稱為「太空課堂」。學生可在神舟二十三號任務期間，直接與身處中國太空站的黎家盈通話。
黎家盈早前以載荷專家身份進入天宮太空站，成為香港首位航天員。當局希望透過活動啟發青少年對科學及太空探索的興趣。
